description: You draw power from shadow and darkness.

features.name: Eyes of Darkness
features.description: See in darkness magical or nonmagical within 120 feet.

features.name: Strength of the Shadows
features.description: Advantage on Stealth checks. Dex and Cha checks in dim light have advantage.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.description: Spend sorcery points to summon shadow hound to attack enemies.
